name: hidden-version
description: An audited entity that declares its OWN 'updated_at' and marks it hidden. The schema mapper used to inject a framework-managed column only when the entity did not declare that name, so this declaration won — and masking it dropped the key from every returned record, so no ETag was minted, the caller had nothing to send as If-Match, and optimistic concurrency was off for this entity with nothing raised anywhere. See retyped-version.alvo.json for the strictly worse sibling. This descriptor exists to be REFUSED at apply; nothing here is meant to work.

records.description: An audited entity whose own 'updated_at' declaration replaces the framework's.
